title: Netherstone-Studded Gauntlet
summary: Gortash’s gauntlet adds Force to unarmed attacks, improves spell save DC, and grants Command.

fields.Command: Level 3. Action, 60 ft, once per Long Rest. Up to three eligible creatures make Wisdom saves against your spell save DC. Choose Approach, Drop, Flee, Grovel or Halt. Lasts 1 turn without Concentration. The spell cannot command undead or directly harmful actions.
fields.Availability: Carried by Gortash. Looting it gives Gauntlet of the Tyrant and Gortash’s Netherstone separately.
fields.Base value: 300 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay and acquisition details with pinned source evidence.
